message.content:
This is a festive-attire costume set. Chapter 95 (9505.90) covers festive articles, but Note 1(e) to Chapter 95 excludes fancy dress of textile materials in Chapter 61 or 62, so a costume made of textile apparel is classified in Chapters 61/62. Under HTSUS practice, costumes for carnival or fancy dress are classified in Chapters 61/62 only when they are wearing apparel of textiles.

CBP rulings on similar sets, such as a Samurai warrior costume with a tunic, armor, helmet and similar pieces, usually classify them as a set in 9505.90.6000 if the garments are not substantially of textile construction. Where the tunic is the main component, a ruling may instead classify the set under 6110 or 6209 or 6211. Here the tunic is a long pullover top, the chest armor and helmet are foam, and there is a tabard belt. The Note 1(e) exclusion applies to textile garments, and CBP often treats a costume with a knit tunic as a Chapter 61 garment. However, because this set includes a foam helmet, armor, and accessories, it is a composite or set of mixed items, and CBP commonly classifies these as festive articles under 9505.90.6000. The description says "sample of an adult size costume", which suggests a ruling that treated it as a festive article since the pieces are not of the type of ordinary apparel.

I'll go with 9505.90.6000.
